name: Account
description: A class to specify an account as an account number alongside, optionally. an account name, an account type, an account beneficiary and a servicing party.

accountBeneficiary.description: A reference to the party beneficiary of the account.

accountName.description: The name by which the account is known.

accountType.description: The type of account, e.g. client, house.

partyReference.description: A reference to the party to which the account refers to.

servicingParty.description: The reference to the legal entity that services the account, i.e. in the books of which the account is held.
